B054-09.notes: Sum = 70. Minimize others: 1,2,3 below median, 10, then 11,12 above; max = 70 - 6 - 10 - 23 = 31. 37 is the trap from ignoring 'different' above the median (10,10 repeated / 1,1,1). Needs the optimization insight.

B054-10.notes: Horizontal asymptote y = 3; solving (3x-2)/(x+4) = 3 gives -2 = 12, impossible, so 3 not in range. Others: y=0 at x=2/3, y=1 at x=3, y=-1/2 at x=0. Range-of-rational-function concept is non-routine for typical takers; borderline medium/hard.
